mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 59 degrees under overcast skies out at Badger Prairie County Park, accompanied by a full moon.

The City of Verona is reminding residents to be cautious of scams regarding planning and zoning application fees. Please remember that the city never requests payment via wire transfer or online credit card processing; all fees must be paid by check to the city administration building. Additionally, keep an eye out for fall leaf pickup which begins on October 5th.
Today is a big day with the Verona Fall Fest taking place, while tomorrow you can head over to the Dane County Farmer's Market at the State Capitol or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
On September 5th, the Verona Police Department responded to reports of a social media prank where slices of cheese were placed on vehicle windshields throughout town.
Culver's of Verona is closed for a remodel but will open today at 10:00 AM to serve up their daily flavor.
